about: A run of counts, one bar per period, at the size of a word, without axes or a tooltip. A bar is read by its length, so the bars start at zero.

deploys.about: The week's deploys as a stat with a bar per day beside it. The sparkbar is hidden from assistive technology, because the stat states the figure.
deploys.label: Deploys this week
deploys.title: Beside a figure

incidents.about: label names a run shown without a figure, as an image with that name, here in the error palette. It takes no tab stop.
incidents.label: Incidents per week over the last 12 weeks, 21 in all
incidents.title: Without a figure

orders.about: baseline={120} renders a dashed line at the daily target, and color takes the teal palette's chart color.
orders.help: At or above the 120 target on 4 of 7 days
orders.label: Orders per day
orders.title: Baseline

outage.about: A value that is not a finite number leaves its period empty. A zero leaves it empty too, so the help text names the day without a reading.
outage.label: Sign-ups per day
outage.title: Missing reading

replay.about: animate grows the bars from zero when the sparkbar mounts, and Replay mounts it again. Under reduced motion recharts renders them at once.
replay.label: Deploys per day this week
replay.title: Animation

seats.about: signed renders a fall in the error palette's chart color, for a change per period: seats gained or lost each day over two weeks.
seats.label: Net seats per day
seats.title: Signed

size.about: Three boxes on the grid, four times as wide as they are tall: 64 by 16 pixels at sm, 96 by 24 at md and 128 by 32 at lg.
size.title: Sizes

stretch.about: stretch fills the width of the container at the size's height, here a room 24rem wide.
stretch.title: Stretch

title: Sparkbar
